directions: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on college students doing community service.You are to write an essay on its benefits and the service you can provide to the community. You will have 30 minutes for the task.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
College students engaging in community service brings numerous benefits. To begin with, it offers practical experience. For example, by participating in environmental protection projects in the community, students can learn how to apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios. In addition, it helps students develop a sense of social responsibility. When they assist the elderly or the disabled in the community, they understand the importance of caring for others.

As for the service I can provide, I'm good at tutoring. I can offer free academic guidance to primary school students in the community, helping them with their homework and improving their study skills. Moreover, I can organize cultural activities, like book-sharing sessions, to enrich the spiritual life of community residents.

In conclusion, college students' community service is a win-win situation. It not only benefits the community but also promotes students' personal growth.
